mentions.h: MARCH 26th 1977 - CRANFORD - THAMES VALLEY H ROAD RELAY
mentions.note: Belgrave C team, Thames Valley H road relay, Cranford: 17:11 (58); his time questioned in note
newcomer; not at his best, team back to 23rd; 'one of our most exciting prospects'; 28:13 (23)
ran the 10th stage for the A team; Silver Jubilee Relay: A team stage 10 4.28
